name: Valuable
one_liner: Real-time valuation intelligence — what a country, a city, a company or your startup is actually worth, and which decisions moved the number.
notes: Origin: Musk's 'How much is it?' re the UK (12 Aug 2026). Headline national net-worth numbers are commodity (journalists derived GBP 13.31tn from the free ONS bulletin same-day). The moat is the event-annotation layer: leadership, parties and policy decisions tied to movements in the valuation series. Slice 1 = UK vertical slice end-to-end (UK + London + one public company + one startup simulator) on one shared engine and schema. Data: DuckDB build layer -> Postgres serve layer.
